description: A digital temperature and humidity sensor using a proprietary one-wire protocol.
how_to_use: Wire the SDA pin to any digital pin — despite the name, this is NOT I2C, just a one-wire data line, and works on any ordinary digital pin.

plain.what: Measures temperature and how humid (damp) the air is.
plain.how: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, the data pin to an Arduino pin (with a 10 kΩ resistor to 5V). The DHT library gives you the numbers.
